title: A pinned WezTerm installer that /kb-setup offers as an optional dependency
goal: _tools/install_wezterm.py installs a pinned WezTerm release for macOS, Windows or Linux into a per-user directory without changing PATH or a shell profile, refusing a download whose SHA-256 is not the pin with nothing installed; --plan prints each OS's pinned URL and SHA-256; --declined prints the saved text for a person who declines: WezTerm is optional, the chat pane still works, kbmon runs by hand or Claude reads it with python3 _tools/kbmon.py --once; /kb-setup asks the person before installing it, says it is not a critical dependency and quotes that text on a no

run:
import subprocess as s,sys
p=s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/install_wezterm.py','--declined'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=60);o=p.stdout.lower()
ok=p.returncode==0 and 'optional' in o and 'kbmon.py --once' in o and 'pane' in o
print(p.stdout);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

import sys
t=open('.claude/skills/kb-setup/SKILL.md',encoding='utf-8').read()
i=t.find('install_wezterm')
ok=i>=0 and '--declined' in t[i-600:i+1200] and 'optional' in t[i-600:i+1200].lower()
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
